jobs.description: 1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner TasksAs a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.What You'll Do * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones * Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively * Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration * Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work * Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targetsRequirements * Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement * Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps * 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products * Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number * Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence * A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide * High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief * Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English * A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challengedNice to have * Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting * Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures) * Product marketing or positioning background * Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)BenefitsThe Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.Feedback Culture: open, and direct.Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.Application processWe run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. jobs.description: 1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing. * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz. * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies. * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences. * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense. * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise.
